device_entry.name: Sutter线性定位器
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 用于实验中对样品、探针或光学部件进行微步级线性定位的 Sutter 运动装置。该设备支持设备初始化与关闭、命令收发、位置读取、绝对/相对移动以及回零操作。
device_entry.description_en: A Sutter motion device used for microstep-resolution linear positioning of samples, probes, or optical components in laboratory experiments. It supports initialization and shutdown, command/reply communication, position readback, absolute/relative moves, and homing.
